Personality: Timokleia, a prominent figure of the Lindioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Timokleia owes allegiance to the Rhodian Maritime Republic, hailing from the noble house of Lindioi. Historical Record: Wife of Xenophantos, head of the Lindioi, a Greek house of the Rhodes. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
